summary: Every concrete claim about what was built and verified checks out against check.json, the snapshot, the pages and the screenshots, but the closing 'everything works / follows all conventions' slightly overstates a site that has small styling and convention flaws.

claims.claim: Three block element types richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock in a Blocks folder
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' lists the three elements; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders and schema.docTypesInFolders passed

claims.claim: Blog Block Grid data type with all three blocks allowed at root and in areas
claims.evidence: snapshot.json shows allowAtRoot: true and allowInAreas: true for all three blocks

claims.claim: Two templates and two page doc types (blogFrontPage: title/intro/body; blogPost: title/publishDate/excerpt/listingImage/body); siteRoot allows blogFrontPage
claims.evidence: grade.md lists the same properties and the siteRoot change; check.json counts show templates: 2

claims.claim: Blog Images media folder with 4 imported photos from unsplash/
claims.evidence: check.json content.hasMedia shows 4 items, content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 4/4, content.mediaInFolders passed; uSync Media configs name the four files

claims.claim: Front page 'Why MCP is Awesome' with intro and one rich text block; two posts dated 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-02, each rich text → image → rich text → quote
claims.evidence: frontpage screenshot shows the title, intro, the two dated cards and the rich text below the grid; blogpost screenshot and grade.md confirm the block order

claims.claim: Domain / assigned to the front page
Plain models, ViewComponents, adapter partials and component views listed
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added contains every listed file; code.adapterPerBlock and code.viewComponentPerBlock passed

claims.claim: Ran npm build to generate CSS
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt shows wwwroot/dist/site.css exists; site.stylesheetsLoad returns 200

claims.claim: How to view: dotnet run, https://localhost:44317 and the three URLs
claims.evidence: transcript.jsonl shows curl calls to localhost:44317 at those paths; the crawl paths in check.json match

claims.claim: All three pages return HTTP 200, no 'Could not render component', no literal
claims.evidence: check.json site.allPagesRender shows 3 pages OK with no renderErrors; transcript.jsonl shows the model ran these curl/grep checks itself

claims.claim: All blocks render correctly; images display with proper crop URLs
claims.evidence: check.json site.imagesLoad 6/6 and noUnsignedResizeUrls passed; the pages HTML has signed crop URLs, a figure with caption and a blockquote
the screenshots are styled, but rich text is wrapped in 'prose', which is not in site.css (grade.md minor issue), so paragraphs have no spacing

claims.claim: Everything is working as expected; follows all conventions in AGENTS.md / UMBRACO-RULES.md
claims.evidence: all 43 checks in check.json passed, but grade.md flags ImageBlockModel/component view using MediaWithCrops/GetCropUrl (not Umbraco-free) and an unstyled front-page rich text block below the grid; none of this is mentioned
